description: Atomic batch of static endpoint group management operations. Operations are applied in order inside one transaction; either all commit or none do. `requestId` values must be unique within the request. Physical control is never part of this request. Every operation that writes a group advances its etag by one, so a later operation on a group already written in the same request must send the etag the earlier operation reports; each result reports the group's etag right after its operation.

validateOnly.description: When true, runs authorization and validation and returns what would happen, writing nothing. A validate-only request neither requires nor consumes an `Idempotency-Key`.
